sloka: पुनरेवं ब्रुवाणं तं भरतं लक्ष्मणाग्रज: ।प्रत्युवाच तत: श्रीमान् ज्ञातिमध्ये ऽभिसत्कृत: ॥ २.१०७.१॥
transliteration: punarevaṁ bruvāṇaṁ taṁ bharataṁ lakṣmaṇāgraja: ।pratyuvāca tata: śrīmān jñātimadhye 'bhisatkṛta: ॥ 2.107.1॥

translations.english: Wellhonoured in the midst of relatives, the celebrated Rama, elder brother of Lakshmana, then said to Bharata who was going to speak again.
